name: head-cave
description: A head-sized CAVE: three Planar Clarity Matrix G3 MX46X 46-inch LCD panels (1920 x 1080, 1.018 x 0.573 m active area, 1.7 mm tiled bezel) in landscape as front, left and right screens, bottom edges 40 in (1.016 m) off the floor, one computer with three displays that also takes input and plays the sound. Viewer's head at the center of the box, floor at y = 0.
